_comment: Curated directory of third-party APIs, ported from the previous Python site (data/apis.json). Rendered at /directory/. Append an object with name, category, description, auth, free_tier and docs to add an entry.

apis.name: Anthropic Claude API
apis.description: Text generation, tool use, vision and agentic workflows. Strong at long-context reasoning and code.

apis.name: Hugging Face Inference API
apis.description: Hosted inference for hundreds of thousands of open models: text, vision, audio, embeddings.

apis.name: Ollama
apis.description: Run open-weight LLMs locally behind a REST API. No key, no quota, no network dependency.

apis.name: Groq
apis.description: Very low-latency inference for open models. Useful when response speed dominates your design.

apis.name: Google Gemini API
apis.description: Multimodal generation with a long context window and a genuinely usable free tier.

apis.name: Deepgram
apis.description: Speech-to-text with streaming, diarisation and word-level timestamps.

apis.name: OpenAlex
apis.description: Open catalogue of ~250M scholarly works, authors, institutions and citation graphs. Replaces Microsoft Academic Graph.

apis.name: Crossref
apis.description: Authoritative DOI metadata for journal articles, books and preprints. The canonical source for citations.

apis.name: Semantic Scholar
apis.description: Paper metadata, abstracts, citation contexts and influence scores, with embeddings for similarity search.

apis.name: arXiv
apis.description: Query and retrieve preprints across physics, maths, CS, biology and economics.

apis.name: Zenodo
apis.description: Deposit datasets and papers programmatically and mint a DOI. CERN-operated, permanent archive.

apis.name: PubMed / NCBI E-utilities
apis.description: Search and fetch across PubMed, GenBank, PMC and other NCBI biomedical databases.

apis.name: Unpaywall
apis.description: Find legal open-access copies of paywalled papers by DOI.

apis.name: Wikipedia / Wikimedia REST
apis.description: Article content, summaries, pageview analytics and structured Wikidata links.

apis.name: Wikidata SPARQL
apis.description: Query a structured knowledge graph of ~100M entities with real SPARQL. Extremely powerful for research joins.

apis.name: Open-Meteo
apis.description: Forecast, historical reanalysis and climate model data. No API key at all — the best weather API for hobby use.

apis.name: OpenStreetMap Nominatim
apis.description: Forward and reverse geocoding from OSM data. Respect the usage policy or self-host.

apis.name: Overpass API
apis.description: Query raw OpenStreetMap geometry — every café, footpath or building in a bounding box.

apis.name: USGS Earthquake
apis.description: Real-time and historical global seismic events as GeoJSON.

apis.name: NASA Open APIs
apis.description: Earth imagery, APOD, near-Earth objects, Mars rover photos and more under one key.

apis.name: IPinfo
apis.description: IP to geolocation, ASN and carrier data. Clean responses, generous free plan.

apis.name: Frankfurter
apis.description: Exchange rates published by the European Central Bank, including full history. No key.

apis.name: CoinGecko
apis.description: Crypto prices, market caps and historical charts across thousands of assets.

apis.name: Alpha Vantage
apis.description: Equities, forex and technical indicators with a long history. Rate limited but free.

apis.name: World Bank Open Data
apis.description: Development indicators for every country back to 1960 — GDP, population, health, education.

apis.name: FRED
apis.description: 800,000+ US and international economic time series from the St. Louis Fed.

apis.name: GitHub REST & GraphQL
apis.description: Repos, issues, actions, releases and code search. The GraphQL endpoint is far more efficient for bulk reads.

apis.name: Cloudflare Workers
apis.description: Deploy serverless functions at the edge, plus KV, R2 storage and D1 SQL. Excellent free allowance.

apis.name: Supabase
apis.description: Postgres with an auto-generated REST and realtime API, auth and file storage.

apis.name: Resend
apis.description: Transactional email with a clean API and good deliverability. Simple pricing.

apis.name: Upstash Redis
apis.description: Serverless Redis over HTTP — works from edge runtimes where TCP is unavailable.

apis.name: httpbin
apis.description: Echo server for testing HTTP clients: headers, status codes, delays, auth flows.

apis.name: JSONPlaceholder
apis.description: Fake REST data for prototyping UIs before a real backend exists.

apis.name: Have I Been Pwned
apis.description: Check passwords against known breaches using k-anonymity — the range endpoint needs no key.

apis.name: Unsplash
apis.description: High-quality free-to-use photography with search and attribution metadata.

apis.name: Open Library
apis.description: Book metadata, covers and full-text search across the Internet Archive's catalogue.

apis.name: TMDB
apis.description: Film and TV metadata, artwork, credits and ratings. Community maintained.

apis.name: Internet Archive
apis.description: Search and retrieve archived pages, books, audio and software. Includes the Wayback Machine.

apis.name: data.gov
apis.description: Catalogue of ~300,000 US federal datasets, queryable via CKAN.

apis.name: EU Open Data Portal
apis.description: Datasets published by EU institutions, with SPARQL and REST access.

apis.name: WHO GHO OData
apis.description: Global health indicators by country and year — mortality, disease burden, coverage.

apis.name: UN Comtrade
apis.description: Bilateral trade flows by commodity and country, going back decades.

apis.name: REST Countries
apis.description: Country reference data: codes, currencies, languages, borders, flags.

apis.name: GDELT
apis.description: Global news events and tone, updated every 15 minutes across 100+ languages.
